name: Raw Typst Sales Invoice
typst_code:
// Section: Section 1
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  align: (left, right),
  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 {
    (bottom: (thickness: 0.5pt, cap: "round", paint: rgb("#00519B")))
  },
  [#text(font: "Inter 18pt", size: 14pt, weight: 800, tracking: 1.2pt)[#doc.doctype]],
  [#text(font: "Veneer Two", size: 18pt, red, tracking: 1.2pt)[#doc.name]]
)

// Section: Section 2
#grid(
  columns: (2fr, 2fr, 1fr),
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Customer Name]#linebreak()#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.customer_name]],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Date]#linebreak()#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.posting_date]],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Payment Due Date]#linebreak()#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.due_date]],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Address]#linebreak()#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.address_display]],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Contact]#linebreak()#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.contact_display]],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Mobile No]#linebreak()#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.contact_mobile]],
)

// Section: Section 3
// Table: Items
#show table.cell.where(x: 0): strong
#show table.cell.where(y: 0): strong
#if type(doc.items) == array and doc.items.len() > 0 [
  #table(
    columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, auto, auto, auto),
    align: (left, left, left, right, right, right),
    table.header([Item], [Description], [UOM], [Quantity], [Rate], [Amount]),
    ..doc.items.map(row => (
      [#row.item_code], [#row.description], [#row.uom], [#row.qty], [#row.rate], [#row.amount]
    )).flatten(),
  )
]

// Section: Terms and Conditions & Taxes
#let has_taxes = type(doc.taxes) == array and doc.taxes.len() > 0

#let tax_cells =  if has_taxes {
    doc.taxes.map(tax => (
      [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Tax Description: ]],
      [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[#(tax.description)]],
      
      [],
      [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Tax Amount:]],
      [#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#(tax.tax_amount)]],
      
      [],
    )).flatten()
  } else {
    ()
  }
#v(2em)
#grid(
  columns: (2fr, auto, 1fr),
  align: (left, right, right),

  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Terms and Conditions]],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[SubTotal:]],
  [#align(right)[#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.total]]],
  
  [#text(..fieldValueStyle)[#doc.terms]],
  ..tax_cells,
  [], [], [],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[Grand Total:]],
  [#align(right)[#text(font: "Inter 18pt", weight: 800, rgb("#009051"), size: 18pt)[
    #(if has_taxes { doc.taxes.at(-1).total } else { doc.total })
  ]]],

  [],
  [#text(..fieldLabelStyle)[In Words:]],
  [#text(font: "Inter 18pt",size: 10.50pt)[#doc.in_words]],
)

doc_footer:
#let footer_block = align(right + horizon)[
  #set text(size: 8pt)
  #context counter(page).display("Page: 1 of 1", both: true)
]

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  align: (left, right),
  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 {
    (bottom: (thickness: 0.5pt, cap: "round", paint: rgb("#00519B")))
  },
  [#text(font: "Inter 18pt", size: 14pt, weight: 800)[#doc.doctype]],
  [#text(font: "Veneer Two", size: 18pt, red)[#doc.name]]
)

#let terms_exist = doc.terms != "" and doc.terms != none

Date: #doc.offer_date

Dear #doc.applicant_name,

We are pleased to appoint you in the services of #doc.company on the terms and conditions detailed in this letter.

Your designation shall be *#doc.designation*.

#if type(doc.offer_terms) == array and doc.offer_terms.len() > 0 {
  for row in doc.offer_terms {
    [*#row.offer_term:* #row.value]
    linebreak()
  }
}

Please read the detailed terms as below. If you have any queries, feel free to get in touch with us.
We look forward to your long and fruitful career association with our organisation.
If you decide to join us, 'Welcome to #doc.company !'

*Yours truly,*
#v(4em)

Authorized Signatory
#v(4em)

#doc.company

#if terms_exist {
  pagebreak()
  [#doc.terms]
}
